articles.title_en: Identification of incomplete information allocation-transfer games in monotone equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 单调均衡下不完全信息分配-转移博弈的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops identification results for the distribution of valuations in a class of allocation-transfer games. These games determine an allocation of units of a valuable object and arrangement of monetary transfers on the basis of the actions taken by the players. The results allow dependent valuations, discrete parts of the action space, non-smoothness, and unknown (to the econometrician, prior to observing the data) details of how the allocations and transfers are determined. The identification strategy is based on the assumption of a single monotone equilibrium used in the data, in which players use strategies that are weakly increasing functions of their valuations for the object being allocated. As extensions, the identification strategy accommodates certain relaxations of the equilibrium assumption, while maintaining the assumption of the use of monotone strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对一类分配-转移博弈中估值的分布提出了识别结果。这类博弈根据玩家采取的行动决定有价值物品单位的分配以及货币转移的安排。研究结果允许依赖估值、行动空间的离散部分、非平滑性以及（计量经济学家在观察数据之前未知的）分配和转移确定方式的细节。识别策略基于数据中使用的单一单调均衡的假设，在该均衡中，玩家使用的策略是其对被分配物品估值的弱递增函数。作为扩展，识别策略在保持使用单调策略假设的同时，允许对均衡假设进行某些放宽。

articles.title_en: Five lessons for applied researchers from twenty years of common correlated effects estimation
articles.title_cn: 应用研究者从二十年共同相关效应估计中得到的五个教训
articles.abstract_en: This article distills the vast literature on Common Correlated Effects (CCE), initiated by the seminal contribution of Pesaran (2006), into five practical lessons. We provide a concise overview of the CCE framework and describe the reasons for its popularity in empirical (macro-) panel data research. The lessons we draw focus on aspects that have received substantial methodological attention, but remain underappreciated in empirical work.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文将从Pesaran（2006）开创性贡献引发的共同相关效应（CCE）的大量文献提炼为五个实用教训。我们简要概述了CCE框架，并描述了其在实证（宏观）面板数据研究中受欢迎的原因。我们总结的教训侧重于那些在方法论上受到广泛关注但在实证工作中仍未被充分认识的方面。

articles.title_en: Large-scale model comparison with fast model confidence sets
articles.title_cn: 基于快速模型置信集的大规模模型比较
articles.abstract_en: The paper proposes a new algorithm for finding the confidence set of a collection of forecasts or prediction models. Existing numerical implementations use an elimination approach, where one starts with the full collection of models and successively eliminates the worst performing until the null of equal predictive ability is no longer rejected at a given confidence level. The intuition behind the proposed implementation lies in reversing the process, i.e. starting with a collection of two models and updating both the model rankings and p-values as models are successively added to the collection. The first benefit of this approach is a reduction of one polynomial order in both the time complexity and memory cost of finding the confidence set of a collection of M models using the R rule, falling respectively from OM3 to OM2 and from OM2 to OM. The second key benefit is that it allows for further models to be added at a later point in time, thus enabling collaborative efforts using the model confidence set procedure. The paper proves that this implementation is equivalent to the elimination approach, demonstrates the improved performance on a multivariate GARCH collection consisting of 4800 models, and discusses possible use-cases where this improved performance could prove useful.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新算法，用于寻找一组预测或预测模型的置信集。现有的数值实现采用消除法，即从完整的模型集合开始，依次消除表现最差的模型，直到在给定置信水平下不再拒绝等预测能力的原假设。所提出的实现方法的直觉在于反转这一过程，即从两个模型的集合开始，并随着模型依次加入集合，更新模型排名和p值。该方法的首要优势在于，在使用R规则寻找M个模型集合的置信集时，时间复杂度和内存成本均降低了一个多项式阶数，分别从OM3降至OM2，以及从OM2降至OM。第二个关键优势是，它允许在稍后的时间点添加更多模型，从而通过模型置信集程序促进协作努力。本文证明了该实现与消除法等价，展示了在包含4800个模型的多变量GARCH集合上的性能改进，并讨论了这种改进性能可能证明有用的潜在用例。

articles.title_en: Testing for peer effects without specifying the network structure
articles.title_cn: 在不指定网络结构的情况下检验同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes an Anderson–Rubin (AR) test for the presence of peer effects in panel data without the need to specify the network structure. The unrestricted model of our test is a linear panel data model of social interactions with dyad-specific peer effect coefficients for all potential peers. The proposed AR test evaluates if these peer effect coefficients are all zero. As the number of peer effect coefficients increases with the sample size, so does the number of instrumental variables (IVs) employed to test the restrictions under the null, rendering a many-IV environment of Bekker (1994). By extending existing many-IV asymptotic results to panel data, we establish the asymptotic validity of the proposed AR test. Our Monte Carlo simulations show the robustness and improved performance of the proposed test compared to some existing tests with misspecified networks. We provide two applications to demonstrate its empirical relevance.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种安德森-鲁宾（AR）检验，用于在面板数据中检验同伴效应的存在性，而无需指定网络结构。我们检验的无限制模型是一个具有二元组特定同伴效应系数的线性面板数据社会互动模型，涵盖所有潜在同伴。所提出的AR检验评估这些同伴效应系数是否全部为零。由于同伴效应系数的数量随样本量增加而增加，用于在零假设下检验这些限制的工具变量（IVs）数量也随之增加，从而形成了Bekker（1994）所描述的多工具变量环境。通过将现有的多工具变量渐近结果扩展到面板数据，我们确立了所提出的AR检验的渐近有效性。我们的蒙特卡洛模拟显示，与一些现有网络设定错误的检验相比，所提出的检验具有稳健性和改进的性能。我们提供了两个应用来展示其经验相关性。

articles.title_en: Enhancements of communication-efficient distributed statistical inference and its privacy preservation
articles.title_cn: 通信高效分布式统计推断的改进及其隐私保护
articles.abstract_en: In the modern era of big data, the vast amount of available data has brought more ways to analyze important economic and financial issues. For example, predicting the probability of individual default has become more accurate, as the number of defaulted individuals has increased year-on-year with the increase in data volume, leading to a more detailed characterization of the defaulted population. However, it presents new challenges and one of them is that all samples are separately stored in different machines and cannot be transferred directly for privacy considerations and limited data storage capacity. This paper develops an improved communication-efficient distributed algorithm in which more local summarized information is used to estimate the high-order derivatives of the loss function with lower communication cost. Furthermore, to protect the privacy in the interacted vector, we design a privacy-preserving algorithm based on the differential privacy constraint by adding a Laplace-distributed noise term in the parameters that can be extended to other cases beyond distributed architectures. Both non-private and private schemes, in which only local estimators are passed from the local machine to the central machine, are more theoretically and practically accurate and efficient than their counterparts. Then we suggest a bootstrap scheme to estimate the covariance matrix of the parametric estimators that is beneficial to effective inference. Finally, we find that the proposed method can effectively handle the practical activities that are, accurate probabilistic predictions of default risk and climate activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在大数据时代，海量可用数据为分析重要的经济和金融问题提供了更多途径。例如，预测个体违约概率已变得更加准确，因为随着数据量的增加，违约个体的数量逐年上升，从而对违约人群的特征刻画更为细致。然而，这也带来了新的挑战，其中之一是所有样本分别存储在不同的机器上，且由于隐私考虑和数据存储容量有限，无法直接传输。本文开发了一种改进的通信高效分布式算法，其中利用更多局部汇总信息来估计损失函数的高阶导数，同时降低通信成本。此外，为保护交互向量中的隐私，我们设计了一种基于差分隐私约束的隐私保护算法，在参数中添加拉普拉斯分布噪声项，该算法可扩展到分布式架构之外的其他情形。非隐私和隐私方案（仅将局部估计量从本地机器传递到中央机器）在理论和实践上均比对应方法更准确、更高效。随后，我们提出了一种自助法方案来估计参数估计量的协方差矩阵，这有助于有效的推断。最后，我们发现所提方法能有效处理实际活动，即违约风险和气候活动的准确概率预测。

articles.title_en: Quasi-Bayesian estimation and inference with control functions
articles.title_cn: 控制函数的拟贝叶斯估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a quasi-Bayesian method that integrates frequentist nonparametric estimation with Bayesian inference in a two-stage process. Applied to an endogenous discrete choice model, the approach first uses kernel or sieve estimators to estimate the control function nonparametrically, followed by Bayesian methods to estimate the structural parameters. This combination leverages the advantages of both frequentist tractability for nonparametric estimation and Bayesian computational efficiency for complicated structural models. We analyze the asymptotic properties of the resulting quasi-posterior distribution, finding that its mean provides a consistent estimator for the parameters of interest, although its quantiles do not yield valid confidence intervals. However, bootstrapping the quasi-posterior mean accounts for the estimation uncertainty from the first stage, thereby producing asymptotically valid confidence intervals
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种拟贝叶斯方法，该方法在两步过程中将频率学派的非参数估计与贝叶斯推断相结合。应用于内生离散选择模型时，该方法首先使用核或筛子估计器非参数地估计控制函数，随后采用贝叶斯方法估计结构参数。这种结合利用了频率学派在非参数估计上的可处理性和贝叶斯方法在处理复杂结构模型时的计算效率两方面的优势。我们分析了所得拟后验分布的渐近性质，发现其均值提供了感兴趣参数的一致估计量，尽管其分位数不能产生有效的置信区间。然而，对拟后验均值进行自助抽样可以解释第一阶段估计的不确定性，从而产生渐近有效的置信区间。

articles.title_en: Statistical inference for systemic risk-driven portfolio selection
articles.title_cn: 系统性风险驱动的投资组合选择的统计推断
articles.abstract_en: Portfolio selection in modern finance involves constructing optimal asset allocation strategies that balance risk and return. However, traditional portfolio selection faces new challenges due to systemic events, as exemplified by the financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. In response, we introduce a nonparametric systemic risk-driven portfolio selection approach that models market and portfolio losses using kernel density estimation. In the event of market underperformance, we aim to minimize the conditional expected shortfall (CoES) of portfolio losses while targeting a specific return. We observe that directly estimating CoES using nonparametric kernel methods does not produce a convex objective function with respect to portfolio weights. To address this, we propose an augmentation of the objective function to ensure convexity, guaranteeing a unique solution for optimal portfolio weights regardless of the sample size. Through simulations, we demonstrate our proposed approach’s consistency and out-of-sample performance compared to benchmark portfolio criteria and CoES-based parametric models. Applying this method to a real dataset showcases its superior risk–return performance relative to existing approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代金融中的投资组合选择涉及构建平衡风险与回报的最优资产配置策略。然而，由于系统性事件，如金融危机和COVID-19大流行，传统的投资组合选择面临新的挑战。为此，我们引入了一种非参数系统性风险驱动的投资组合选择方法，使用核密度估计对市场和投资组合损失进行建模。在市场表现不佳的情况下，我们旨在最小化投资组合损失的条件期望短缺（CoES），同时瞄准特定回报。我们观察到，使用非参数核方法直接估计CoES不会产生关于投资组合权重的凸目标函数。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了对目标函数的增强以确保凸性，从而保证无论样本大小如何，最优投资组合权重都有唯一解。通过模拟，我们证明了我们提出的方法相对于基准投资组合标准和基于CoES的参数模型的一致性和样本外表现。将该方法应用于真实数据集，展示了其相对于现有方法在风险-回报表现上的优越性。

articles.title_en: Decomposing informed trading in equity options
articles.title_cn: 分解股票期权中的知情交易
articles.abstract_en: We develop a multi-asset model to decompose informed trading into the components concerning the underlying stock-value and the volatility in equity options. We isolate the stock-value and volatility components by characterizing their distinct intraday price responses in contracts with different option deltas and vegas, respectively. The stock-value (volatility) component represents on average 41 % (19 %) of the option spread, which remains substantial under various statistical validity analyses and robustness checks. In daily empirical applications, we also show that volatility-informed trading anticipates a 'Volmageddon' high-volatility event, and straddle trades are positively associated with volatility-informed trading.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个多资产模型，将知情交易分解为涉及标的股票价值和股票期权波动性的组成部分。我们通过分别刻画不同期权delta和vega合约中不同的日内价格反应，来分离股票价值和波动性成分。股票价值（波动性）成分平均占期权价差的41%（19%），在各种统计有效性分析和稳健性检验下仍然显著。在日常实证应用中，我们还表明，波动性知情交易预示着“波动末日”高波动事件，且跨式交易与波动性知情交易正相关。

articles.title_en: Jump detection in high-frequency order prices
articles.title_cn: 高频订单价格中的跳跃检测
articles.abstract_en: We propose methods to infer jumps of a semi-martingale, which describes long-term price dynamics, based on discrete, noisy, high-frequency observations. Different to the classical model of additive, centered market microstructure noise, we consider one-sided microstructure noise for order prices in a limit order book.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了基于离散、含噪的高频观测来推断半鞅（描述长期价格动态）跳跃的方法。与经典的加性、中心化市场微观结构噪声模型不同，我们考虑了限价订单簿中订单价格的单侧微观结构噪声。

articles.title_en: Difference-in-Differences with compositional changes
articles.title_cn: 构成变化下的双重差分法
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies Difference-in-Differences (DiD) setups with repeated cross-sectional data and potential compositional changes across time periods. We begin our analysis by deriving the efficient influence function and the semiparametric efficiency bound for the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT). We introduce nonparametric estimators that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under mild rate conditions on the estimators of the nuisance functions, exhibiting a type of rate doubly robust (DR) property. Additionally, we document a trade-off related to compositional changes: We derive the asymptotic bias of DR DiD estimators that erroneously exclude compositional changes and the efficiency loss when one fails to correctly rule out compositional changes. We propose a nonparametric Hausman-type test for compositional changes based on these trade-offs. The finite sample performance of the proposed DiD tools is evaluated through Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application. We consider extensions of our framework that accommodate double machine learning procedures with cross-fitting, and setups when some units are observed in both pre- and post-treatment periods. As a by-product of our analysis, we present a new uniform stochastic expansion of the local polynomial multinomial logit estimator, which may be of independent interest.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了重复横截面数据及跨时期潜在构成变化下的双重差分（DiD）设定。我们首先通过推导有效影响函数和平均处理效应（ATT）的半参数效率界来开始分析。我们引入了非参数估计量，在干扰函数估计量的温和速率条件下达到半参数效率界，展现出一种速率双重稳健（DR）性质。此外，我们记录了与构成变化相关的权衡：我们推导了错误排除构成变化的DR DiD估计量的渐近偏差，以及未能正确排除构成变化时的效率损失。基于这些权衡，我们提出了一种非参数的Hausman型构成变化检验。通过蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用评估了所提出的DiD工具的有限样本性能。我们考虑了框架的扩展，以适应带有交叉拟合的双机器学习程序，以及某些单位在预处理和后处理期间均被观测到的设定。作为分析的副产品，我们提出了局部多项式多项逻辑估计量的新的一致随机展开，这可能具有独立的研究价值。

articles.title_en: Functional semiparametric modeling for nonstationary and periodic time series data
articles.title_cn: 非平稳和周期时间序列数据的函数半参数建模
articles.abstract_en: Inspired by a real data example illustrating the periodicity in hog price data, this study aims to analyze time series that exhibit an unknown period alongside complex covariate effects. To address these complexities and effectively handle the data structures, we incorporate the partial functional varying-coefficient single-index model into the classical time series decomposition model. We propose a two-stage estimation procedure designed to accurately estimate the unknown periodic component and the associated covariate functions. In the first stage, the unknown period is estimated using a penalized least squares approach, where the covariate functions are approximated via B-splines rather than being ignored. In the second stage, given the estimated period, we employ B-splines to estimate key components, including the amplitude of the periodic component, the varying-coefficient functions, the single-index link function, and the functional slope function. Asymptotic results for the proposed estimators are derived, encompassing the consistency of the period estimator as well as the asymptotic properties of the estimated periodic sequence and covariate functions. Furthermore, we conduct simulations to validate the superior performance of the proposed method and demonstrate its practical applicability through the aforementioned empirical example.
articles.abstract_cn: 受一个展示生猪价格数据周期性的实际数据示例启发，本研究旨在分析具有未知周期及复杂协变量效应的时间序列。为应对这些复杂性并有效处理数据结构，我们将部分函数变系数单指标模型纳入经典时间序列分解模型。我们提出了一种两阶段估计程序，旨在准确估计未知周期成分及相关协变量函数。在第一阶段，使用惩罚最小二乘法估计未知周期，其中协变量函数通过B样条近似而非忽略。在第二阶段，给定估计的周期，我们采用B样条估计关键成分，包括周期成分的振幅、变系数函数、单指标连接函数和函数斜率函数。推导了所提估计量的渐近结果，涵盖周期估计量的一致性以及估计的周期序列和协变量函数的渐近性质。此外，我们进行模拟以验证所提方法的优越性能，并通过上述实证示例展示其实际适用性。

articles.title_en: Robustness to missing data: breakdown point analysis
articles.title_cn: 对缺失数据的稳健性：崩溃点分析
articles.abstract_en: Missing data is pervasive in econometric applications, and rarely is it plausible that the data are missing (completely) at random. This paper proposes a methodology for studying the robustness of results drawn from incomplete datasets. Selection is measured as the divergence from the distribution of complete observations to the distribution of incomplete observations. The breakdown point is defined as the minimal amount of selection needed to overturn a given result. Reporting point estimates and lower confidence intervals of the breakdown point is a simple, concise way to communicate the robustness of a result. An estimator of the breakdown point is proposed and shown n-consistent and asymptotically normal. This estimator can be applied directly to conclusions drawn from any model identified with the generalized method of moments (GMM) that satisfies mild assumptions. Simulations demonstrate the finite sample performance of the breakdown point estimator on averages, linear regression, and logistic regression. The methodology is illustrated by estimating the breakdown point of conclusions drawn from several randomized controlled trails suffering from missing data due to attrition.
articles.abstract_cn: 缺失数据在计量经济学应用中普遍存在，且数据完全随机缺失的假设很少成立。本文提出了一种研究从不完整数据集中所得结果稳健性的方法。选择效应被度量为其与完整观测分布到不完整观测分布的偏离程度。崩溃点定义为推翻给定结果所需的最小选择量。报告崩溃点的点估计和置信区间下界是一种简单、简洁地传达结果稳健性的方式。本文提出了崩溃点的一个估计量，并证明其具有n一致性和渐近正态性。该估计量可直接应用于任何满足温和假设的广义矩方法（GMM）识别模型所得出的结论。模拟实验展示了崩溃点估计量在均值、线性回归和逻辑回归中的有限样本表现。本文通过估计若干因流失而存在缺失数据的随机对照试验所得结论的崩溃点，对该方法进行了说明。

articles.title_en: Bootstraps for dynamic panel threshold models
articles.title_cn: 动态面板阈值模型的Bootstrap方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops valid bootstrap inference methods for the dynamic short panel threshold regression. We show that the standard nonparametric bootstrap is inconsistent for the first-differenced generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator. The inconsistency arises from an n1/4-consistent non-normal asymptotic distribution of the threshold estimator when the true parameter lies in the continuity region of the parameter space, which stems from the rank deficiency of the approximate Jacobian of the sample moment conditions on the continuity region. To address this, we propose a grid bootstrap to construct confidence intervals for the threshold and a residual bootstrap to construct confidence intervals for the coefficients. They are shown to be valid regardless of the model’s continuity. Moreover, we establish a uniform validity for the grid bootstrap. A set of Monte Carlo experiments compares the proposed bootstraps with the standard nonparametric bootstrap. An empirical application to a firm investment model illustrates our methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为动态短面板阈值回归开发了有效的Bootstrap推断方法。我们证明，标准非参数Bootstrap对一阶差分广义矩（GMM）估计量是不一致的。这种不一致性源于当真实参数位于参数空间的连续区域时，阈值估计量具有n1/4-一致的非正态渐近分布，而这又源于样本矩条件在连续区域上的近似雅可比矩阵秩不足。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种网格Bootstrap来构建阈值的置信区间，以及一种残差Bootstrap来构建系数的置信区间。无论模型是否连续，这些方法都被证明是有效的。此外，我们建立了网格Bootstrap的一致有效性。一系列蒙特卡洛实验将所提出的Bootstrap方法与标准非参数Bootstrap进行了比较。一个关于企业投资模型的实证应用说明了我们的方法。

articles.title_en: Inference for time-varying factor models under local stationarity
articles.title_cn: 局部平稳条件下时变因子模型的推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers estimation of and testing for a class of locally stationary time series factor models with evolutionary dynamics, where the entries and dimension of the factor loading matrix are allowed to vary with time while the factors and idiosyncratic components are locally stationary. We propose an adaptive sieve estimator for the span of the time-varying loading matrix of a locally stationary factor process. A uniformly consistent estimator of the effective number of factors is developed via eigenanalysis of a non-negative definite time-varying matrix. We also propose a possibly high-dimensional bootstrap test for the hypothesis of constant factor loadings by comparing the kernels of the covariance matrices of the whole time series with their local counterparts. This test avoids the assumption that factors and idiosyncratic errors are stationary or the covariance matrix of factors is time-invariant. Our results cover both cases of white noise idiosyncratic errors and serially correlated idiosyncratic errors. We examine the finite sample performance of our proposed estimator and test via simulation studies and real data analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑一类具有演化动态的局部平稳时间序列因子模型的估计与检验，其中因子载荷矩阵的元素和维度允许随时间变化，而因子和特质成分是局部平稳的。我们提出了一种自适应筛估计量，用于估计局部平稳因子过程的时变载荷矩阵的跨度。通过非负定时间变化矩阵的特征分析，我们开发了一个有效因子数的一致估计量。我们还提出了一个可能高维的bootstrap检验，用于检验常数因子载荷的假设，通过比较整个时间序列的协方差矩阵的核与其局部对应部分。该检验避免了因子和特质误差是平稳的或因子协方差矩阵是时间不变的假设。我们的结果涵盖了白噪声特质误差和序列相关特质误差两种情况。我们通过模拟研究和实际数据分析检验了我们提出的估计量和检验的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Unobserved component models, approximate filters and dynamic adaptive mixture models
articles.title_cn: 不可观测成分模型、近似滤波与动态自适应混合模型
articles.abstract_en: State estimation in unobserved component models with parameter uncertainty is traditionally performed through approximate filters, where Gaussian distributions with given moments are employed to replace otherwise intractable conditional densities. This paper re-examines signal-plus-noise models where parameter uncertainty is induced by a latent variable that may assume a fixed number of states. First, it is shown that, for these models, the approximate filters commonly adopted in the literature can be obtained as linear combinations of minimum variance linear unbiased estimators. Second, it is observed that they coincide with filters implied by a novel class of dynamic adaptive mixture models, where the parameters of a mixture of distributions evolve over time following a recursion that is based on the score of the one-step-ahead predictive distribution. Focusing on a robust specification, where the mixture components are Student’s t distributions, we prove existence, stationarity, and ergodicity of the data generating process as well as invertibility of the filter, and consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator of the static parameters. An application to energy spot prices is discussed, where the novel specification is compared with, and shown to outperform, robust score-driven filters and the related class of mixture autoregressive models.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有参数不确定性的不可观测成分模型中，状态估计传统上通过近似滤波进行，其中使用具有给定矩的高斯分布来替代原本难以处理的条件密度。本文重新审视了信号加噪声模型，其中参数不确定性由可能取固定数量状态的潜在变量引起。首先，研究表明，对于这些模型，文献中常用的近似滤波可以表示为最小方差线性无偏估计量的线性组合。其次，观察到它们与一类新颖的动态自适应混合模型所隐含的滤波一致，在该模型中，混合分布的参数随时间演变，遵循基于一步预测分布得分的递归。聚焦于稳健设定，其中混合成分为学生t分布，我们证明了数据生成过程的存在性、平稳性和遍历性，以及滤波的可逆性，和静态参数最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。讨论了在能源现货价格中的应用，其中新颖设定与稳健得分驱动滤波及相关混合自回归模型类别进行比较，并显示出优于后者。

articles.title_en: Decomposition and interpretation of treatment effects in settings with delayed outcomes
articles.title_cn: 延迟结果环境中治疗效果的分解和解释
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies settings where the analyst is interested in identifying and estimating the average direct causal effect of a binary treatment on an outcome. We consider a setup in which the outcome realization does not get immediately realized after the treatment assignment, a feature that is ubiquitous in empirical settings. The period between the treatment and the realization of the outcome allows other observed actions to occur and affect the outcome. In this context, we study several regression-based estimands routinely used in empirical work to capture the average treatment effect and shed light on interpreting them in terms of ceteris paribus effects, indirect causal effects, and selection terms. We obtain three main and related takeaways under a common set of assumptions. First, the three most popular estimands do not generally satisfy what we call strong sign preservation, in the sense that these estimands may be negative even when the treatment positively affects the outcome conditional on any possible combination of other actions. Second, the most popular regression that includes the other actions as controls satisfies strong sign preservation if and only if these actions are mutually exclusive binary variables. Finally, we show that a linear regression that fully stratifies the other actions leads to estimands that satisfy strong sign preservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了分析师有兴趣识别和估计二元治疗对结果的平均直接因果效应的环境。我们考虑一种设置，其中结果实现在治疗分配后不会立即实现，这是经验设置中普遍存在的特征。治疗和实现结果之间的这段时间允许其他观察到的行为发生并影响结果。在这种背景下，我们研究了实证工作中常用的几种基于回归的估计量，以捕获平均治疗效果，并阐明在其他条件不变的情况下效应、间接因果效应和选择项方面解释它们。我们在一组共同的假设下获得了三个主要且相关的结论。首先，三个最受欢迎的估计量通常不满足我们所说的强符号保留，即即使治疗对结果产生积极影响（以任何可能的其他行动组合为条件），这些估计量也可能是负面的。其次，当且仅当这些动作是互斥的二元变量时，包含其他动作作为控制的最流行的回归满足强符号保留。最后，我们表明，将其他动作完全分层的线性回归会产生满足强符号保留的估计值。

articles.title_en: Quantile approach to intertemporal consumption with multiple assets
articles.title_cn: 多资产跨期消费的分位数方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel economic model and econometric methods to jointly identify and estimate parameters related to intertemporal preference and risk attitude. We begin by formulating an intertemporal consumption model with multiple assets based on dynamic quantile preferences that account for elasticity of intertemporal substitution, risk attitude, and discount factor. We establish the properties of the model and obtain interesting explicit expressions for the value function, and the optimal consumption. In addition, we derive the quantile Euler equation. From this equilibrium condition, we show that, when at least two returns are available, one is able to separately identify the risk attitude, which is measured by the quantile τ, and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution and discount factor. We propose new econometric theory for estimating these parameters of interest and establish the statistical properties of the semiparametric two-step estimator. In particular, we show that the estimator is consistent, with a cubic-root rate of convergence, derive its limiting distribution, and suggest a subsampling procedure for inference. Finally, we empirically estimate the structural model, and results show evidence that discount factor is slightly smaller than one, the elasticity of intertemporal substitution is larger than one, and risk attitude is close to the median.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个新颖的经济模型和计量经济学方法，以联合识别和估计与跨期偏好和风险态度相关的参数。我们首先基于动态分位数偏好构建了一个包含多种资产的跨期消费模型，该模型考虑了跨期替代弹性、风险态度和贴现因子。我们确立了模型的性质，并获得了价值函数和最优消费的有趣显式表达式。此外，我们推导了分位数欧拉方程。从这一均衡条件中，我们表明，当至少有两种回报可用时，能够分别识别由分位数τ衡量的风险态度，以及跨期替代弹性和贴现因子。我们提出了用于估计这些感兴趣参数的新计量经济学理论，并建立了半参数两步估计量的统计性质。特别地，我们证明了该估计量是一致的，具有立方根收敛速率，推导了其极限分布，并建议使用子抽样程序进行推断。最后，我们实证估计了结构模型，结果显示贴现因子略小于一，跨期替代弹性大于一，风险态度接近中位数。

articles.title_en: Non-Parametric identification of stationary dynamic discrete choice models
articles.title_cn: 平稳动态离散选择模型的非参数识别
articles.abstract_en: We provide new non-parametric identification results for stationary dynamic discrete choice models, where both the flow utilities and the distribution of unobserved shocks are fully non-parametric. Our main identification result establishes that a multinomial choice model is non-parametrically identified when there is a special regressor that (i) has a known derivative in the utility function (e.g., enters utility quasi-linearly); (ii) only affects the evolution of the other variables indirectly through the policy function; and (iii) exhibits a type of bounded persistence. To our knowledge, this is the first non-parametric identification result for stationary models that does not require any state variable to exhibit a form of serial independence. Our identification arguments map conditional choice probabilities and the state transition process into structural primitives, and they can be applied to models with persistent unobserved heterogeneity. Our identification results have broad applicability in practice, since candidate variables for the special regressor are already common in the empirical literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为平稳动态离散选择模型提供了新的非参数识别结果，其中流动效用和未观测冲击的分布都是完全非参数的。我们的主要识别结果表明，当存在一个特殊回归变量时，多项式选择模型可以被非参数识别，该变量满足：(i) 在效用函数中具有已知导数（例如，以拟线性方式进入效用）；(ii) 仅通过政策函数间接影响其他变量的演化；(iii) 表现出一种有界持续性。据我们所知，这是首个不需要任何状态变量表现出某种序列独立性的平稳模型的非参数识别结果。我们的识别论证将条件选择概率和状态转移过程映射为结构原始要素，并且可以应用于具有持久未观测异质性的模型。我们的识别结果在实践中具有广泛的适用性，因为特殊回归变量的候选变量在实证文献中已经很常见。

articles.title_en: Exogenous consideration and extended random utility
articles.title_cn: 外生考虑集与扩展随机效用
articles.abstract_en: In a consideration set model, an individual maximizes utility among the considered alternatives. I relate an exogenous consideration set additive random utility model to classic discrete choice and the extended additive random utility model, in which utility can be −∞ for infeasible alternatives. When observable utility shifters are bounded, all three models are observationally equivalent. Moreover, they have the same counterfactual bounds and welfare formulas given variation in price-like utility indices. For attention interventions, welfare cannot change in the full consideration model but is completely unbounded in the limited consideration model. The identified set for consideration set probabilities has a minimal width for any bounded support of shifters, but with unbounded support it is a point: identification “towards” infinity does not resemble identification “at” infinity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在考虑集模型中，个体在被考虑的备选方案中最大化效用。我将外生考虑集加性随机效用模型与经典离散选择及扩展加性随机效用模型联系起来，后者中不可行备选方案的效用可以为−∞。当可观测效用移位因子有界时，这三个模型在观测上等价。此外，在价格类效用指数变化的情况下，它们具有相同的反事实边界和福利公式。对于注意力干预，在完全考虑模型中福利无法改变，但在有限考虑模型中福利完全无界。考虑集概率的识别集在任何有界移位因子支撑下具有最小宽度，但在无界支撑下它是一个点：向无穷的识别并不类似于在无穷处的识别。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference for CP tensor factor models
articles.title_cn: CP张量因子模型的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: High-dimensional tensor-valued data have recently gained attention from researchers in economics and finance. We consider the estimation and inference of high-dimensional tensor factor models, where each dimension of the tensor diverges. Our focus is on a factor model that admits CP-type tensor decomposition, which allows for non-orthogonal loading vectors. Based on the contemporary covariance matrix, we propose an iterative simultaneous projection estimation method. Our estimator is robust to weak dependence among factors and weak correlation across different dimensions in the idiosyncratic shocks. We establish an inferential theory, demonstrating both consistency and asymptotic normality under relaxed assumptions. Within a unified framework, we consider two eigenvalue ratio-based estimators for the number of factors in a tensor factor model and justify their consistency. Simulation studies confirm the theoretical results and an empirical application to sorted portfolios reveals three important factors: a market factor, a long-short factor, and a volatility factor.
articles.abstract_cn: 高维张量值数据近来引起了经济学和金融学研究者的关注。我们考虑高维张量因子模型的估计与推断问题，其中张量的每个维度都发散。我们关注的是允许CP型张量分解的因子模型，该模型允许非正交载荷向量。基于当代协方差矩阵，我们提出了一种迭代同时投影估计方法。我们的估计器对因子间的弱依赖以及异质冲击中不同维度间的弱相关性具有稳健性。我们建立了推断理论，在宽松假设下证明了一致性和渐近正态性。在统一框架内，我们考虑了两种基于特征值比率的张量因子数估计器，并证明了它们的一致性。模拟研究证实了理论结果，对排序投资组合的实证应用揭示了三个重要因子：市场因子、多空因子和波动率因子。

articles.title_en: Multivariate kernel regression in vector and product metric spaces
articles.title_cn: 向量与乘积度量空间中的多元核回归
articles.abstract_en: This paper derives limit properties of nonparametric kernel regression estimators without requiring existence of density for regressors in Rq. In functional regression limit properties are established for multivariate functional regression. The rate and asymptotic normality for the Nadaraya–Watson (NW) estimator is established for distributions of regressors in Rq that allow for mass points, factor structure, multicollinearity and nonlinear dependence, as well as fractal distribution; when bounded density exists we provide statistical guarantees for the standard rate and the asymptotic normality without requiring smoothness. We demonstrate faster convergence associated with dimension reducing types of singularity, such as a fractal distribution or a factor structure in the regressors. The paper extends asymptotic normality of kernel functional regression to multivariate regression over a product of any number of metric spaces. Finite sample evidence confirms rate improvement due to singularity in regression over Rq. For functional regression the simulations underline the importance of accounting for multiple functional regressors. We demonstrate the applicability and advantages of the NW estimator in our empirical study, which reexamines the job training program evaluation based on the LaLonde data.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文推导了非参数核回归估计量的极限性质，无需要求Rq中回归变量存在密度。在函数回归中，建立了多元函数回归的极限性质。对于Rq中允许质量点、因子结构、多重共线性和非线性依赖以及分形分布的回归变量分布，建立了Nadaraya–Watson（NW）估计量的速率和渐近正态性；当存在有界密度时，我们为标准速率和渐近正态性提供了统计保证，无需光滑性要求。我们展示了与降维型奇异性（如回归变量中的分形分布或因子结构）相关的更快收敛。本文将核函数回归的渐近正态性扩展到任意数量度量空间乘积上的多元回归。有限样本证据证实了Rq上回归中奇异性带来的速率改进。对于函数回归，模拟强调了考虑多个函数回归变量的重要性。我们在实证研究中展示了NW估计量的适用性和优势，该研究基于LaLonde数据重新审视了职业培训项目评估。

articles.title_en: Empirical welfare maximization with constraints
articles.title_cn: 带约束的经验福利最大化
articles.abstract_en: Empirical Welfare Maximization (EWM) is a framework that can be used to select welfare program eligibility policies based on data. This paper extends EWM by allowing for uncertainty in estimating the budget needed to implement the selected policy, in addition to its welfare. Due to the additional estimation error, I show there exist no rules that achieve the highest welfare possible while satisfying a budget constraint uniformly over a wide range of DGPs. This differs from the setting without a budget constraint where uniformity is achievable. I propose an alternative trade-off rule and illustrate it with Medicaid expansion, a setting with imperfect take-up and varying program costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 经验福利最大化（EWM）是一个基于数据选择福利项目资格政策的框架。本文通过允许在估计实施所选政策所需预算时存在不确定性，以及其福利的不确定性，扩展了EWM。由于额外的估计误差，我证明不存在任何规则能在满足预算约束的同时，在广泛的数据生成过程（DGPs）上统一实现最高可能的福利。这与无预算约束且可实现统一性的情况不同。我提出了一种替代的权衡规则，并以医疗补助扩展为例进行说明，该情境涉及不完全的接受率和变化的项目成本。

articles.title_en: Data-driven policy learning for continuous treatments
articles.title_cn: 连续处理变量的数据驱动政策学习
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies policy learning for continuous treatments from observational data. Continuous treatments present more significant challenges than discrete ones because population welfare may need nonparametric estimation, and policy space may be infinite-dimensional and may satisfy shape restrictions. We propose to approximate the policy space with a sequence of finite-dimensional spaces and, for any given policy, obtain the empirical welfare by applying the kernel method. We consider two cases: known and unknown propensity scores. In the latter case, we allow for machine learning of the propensity score and modify the empirical welfare to account for the effect of machine learning. The learned policy maximizes the empirical welfare or the modified empirical welfare over the approximating space. In both cases, we modify the penalty algorithm proposed in Mbakop and Tabord-Meehan (2021) to data-automate the tuning parameters (i.e., bandwidth and dimension of the approximating space) and establish an oracle inequality for the welfare regret.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了从观测数据中对连续处理变量进行政策学习的问题。连续处理变量比离散处理变量带来更显著的挑战，因为总体福利可能需要非参数估计，且政策空间可能是无限维的并可能满足形状限制。我们提出用一系列有限维空间来逼近政策空间，并且对于任何给定的政策，通过应用核方法获得经验福利。我们考虑两种情况：倾向得分已知和未知。在后一种情况下，我们允许对倾向得分进行机器学习，并修改经验福利以考虑机器学习的影响。学习到的政策在逼近空间上最大化经验福利或修改后的经验福利。在两种情况下，我们修改了Mbakop和Tabord-Meehan (2021)提出的惩罚算法，以数据自动化的方式调整调参参数（即带宽和逼近空间的维度），并为福利遗憾建立了一个神谕不等式。

articles.title_en: Multi-horizon test for market frictions
articles.title_cn: 市场摩擦的多时间跨度检验
articles.abstract_en: We test for the presence of market frictions that induce transitory deviations of observed asset prices from the underlying efficient prices. Our test is based on the joint inference of return covariances across multiple horizons. We demonstrate that a small set of horizons suffices to identify a broad spectrum of frictions, both theoretically and practically. Our method works for high- and low-frequency data under different asymptotic regimes. Extensive simulations show our method outperforms widely used state-of-the-art tests. Our empirical studies indicate that intraday transaction prices from recent years can be considered effectively friction-free at significantly higher frequencies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们检验是否存在导致观测资产价格与潜在有效价格产生暂时性偏离的市场摩擦。我们的检验基于跨多个时间跨度的收益协方差的联合推断。我们证明，无论在理论上还是实践中，一小部分时间跨度就足以识别广泛的市场摩擦类型。我们的方法适用于不同渐近框架下的高频和低频数据。大量模拟显示，我们的方法优于广泛使用的最新检验方法。我们的实证研究表明，近年来的日内交易价格在显著更高的频率下可以被视为实际上无摩擦的。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric treatment effect identification in school choice
articles.title_cn: 学校选择中的非参数处理效应识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies nonparametric identification and estimation of causal effects in centralized school assignment. In many centralized assignment algorithms, students face both lottery-driven variation and regression discontinuity- (RD) driven variation. We characterize the full set of identified atomic treatment effects (aTEs), defined as the conditional average treatment effect between a pair of schools given student characteristics. Atomic treatment effects are the building blocks of more aggregated treatment contrasts, and common approaches to estimating aTE aggregations can mask important heterogeneity. In particular, many aggregations of aTEs put zero weight on aTEs driven by RD variation, and estimators of such aggregations put asymptotically vanishing weight on the RD-driven aTEs. We provide a diagnostic and recommend new aggregation schemes. Lastly, we provide estimators and asymptotic results for inference on these aggregations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了集中式学校分配中因果效应的非参数识别与估计。在许多集中式分配算法中，学生同时面临由抽签驱动的变异和由回归不连续性（RD）驱动的变异。我们刻画了所有可识别的原子处理效应（aTEs）的完整集合，其定义为在给定学生特征条件下，一对学校之间的条件平均处理效应。原子处理效应是更聚合处理对比的构建块，而估计aTE聚合的常见方法可能掩盖重要的异质性。特别是，许多aTE的聚合对由RD驱动的aTE赋予零权重，而这些聚合的估计器对RD驱动的aTE赋予渐近消失的权重。我们提供了一种诊断方法，并推荐了新的聚合方案。最后，我们提供了用于这些聚合推断的估计量和渐近结果。

articles.title_en: Strategic network formation with many agents
articles.title_cn: 多主体战略网络形成
articles.abstract_en: We derive asymptotic approximations for models of strategic network formation, where limits are taken as the number of nodes (agents) increases to infinity. Our framework assumes a random utility model where agents have heterogeneous tastes over links, and payoffs allow for anonymous and non-anonymous interaction effects, and the observed network is assumed to be pairwise stable. Our main results concern convergence of the link intensity from finite pairwise stable networks to the (many-player) limiting distribution. The set of possible limiting distributions is shown to have a fairly simple form and is characterized through aggregate equilibrium conditions, which may permit multiple solutions. We illustrate how these formal results can be used to analyze identification of link preferences and estimate or bound preference parameters. We also derive an analytical expression for agents’ welfare (expected surplus) from the structure of the network.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们推导了战略网络形成模型的渐近近似，其中极限是随着节点（主体）数量趋于无穷大而取的。我们的框架假设一个随机效用模型，其中主体对链接具有异质性偏好，收益允许匿名和非匿名的交互效应，并且观察到的网络被假定为成对稳定。我们的主要结果涉及链接强度从有限成对稳定网络到（多主体）极限分布的收敛性。可能的极限分布集合被证明具有相当简单的形式，并通过总体均衡条件来刻画，这可能允许多个解。我们说明了这些形式化结果如何用于分析链接偏好的识别以及估计或界定偏好参数。我们还从网络结构中推导出主体福利（预期剩余）的解析表达式。

articles.title_en: Uncovering mild drift in asset prices with intraday high-frequency data
articles.title_cn: 利用日内高频数据揭示资产价格中的微弱漂移
articles.abstract_en: Asset prices are commonly represented as a drift-diffusion process, wherein the drift component denotes the anticipated return of the asset within some time frame, while the diffusion component accommodates random shocks. The drift component has substantial practical significance but accurate estimation is typically challenging and has met with limited success in the existing literature except over large time spans. This paper explores a comprehensive range of drift-diffusion models that include constant, linear, trending, and bursting drift. Conditions are identified under which realized squared drift RSD is a reliable tool for gauging integrated squared drift when the time span Tn is large enough. The recently introduced drift-robust quarticity estimator RiceQ is found to retain consistency under twin asymptotics with Tn → ∞ and infill Δn → 0, subject to some constraints on the divergence rate of Tn across different drift specifications. An inferential method of detecting nonzero drift using RSD and RiceQ is proposed and the drift tests are shown to be consistent under different data generating processes with various conditions on Tn. Simulation studies reveal excellent performance of the realized squared drift measure and the drift test in finite samples. The drift test is demonstrated empirically in real-time surveillance of market abnormalities in the Nasdaq Composite Index over two notable sample periods: the dotcom bubble (1996–2003) and the artificial intelligence boom (2016–2024), using intraday data.
articles.abstract_cn: 资产价格通常被表示为漂移-扩散过程，其中漂移成分表示资产在某个时间范围内的预期收益，而扩散成分则容纳随机冲击。漂移成分具有重要的实际意义，但准确估计通常具有挑战性，并且在现有文献中除长时间跨度外成功有限。本文探讨了一系列全面的漂移-扩散模型，包括常数、线性、趋势和爆发性漂移。确定了在时间跨度Tn足够大时，实现平方漂移RSD作为衡量积分平方漂移的可靠工具的条件。新引入的漂移稳健四次方估计量RiceQ在双渐近条件下，即Tn → ∞和填充Δn → 0，且受限于不同漂移规范下Tn的发散速率约束时，保持一致性。提出了一种使用RSD和RiceQ检测非零漂移的推断方法，并证明漂移检验在不同数据生成过程及Tn的各种条件下具有一致性。模拟研究显示，实现平方漂移度量和漂移检验在有限样本中表现优异。漂移检验在纳斯达克综合指数的两个显著样本期内，即互联网泡沫（1996-2003）和人工智能繁荣（2016-2024），使用日内数据进行了实时市场异常监测的实证演示。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference for causal functions with multi-way clustered data
articles.title_cn: 多向聚类数据下因果函数的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose methods for estimation and uniform inference for a broad class of causal functions, such as conditional average treatment effects and continuous treatment effects, under multi-way clustering. The causal function is identified as the conditional expectation of a Neyman-orthogonal signal that depends on high-dimensional nuisance parameters. We introduce a two-step procedure: the first step uses machine learning to estimate the nuisance parameters, and the second step projects the estimated Neyman-orthogonal signal onto a dictionary of basis functions whose dimension grows with the sample size. We consider both full-sample and multi-way cross-fitting approaches to this procedure and derive a functional limit theory for the resulting estimators. For uniform inference, we develop a novel resampling method, the multi-way cluster-robust sieve score bootstrap, which extends the sieve score bootstrap of Chen and Christensen (2018) to settings with multi-way clustering. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed methods exhibit favorable finite-sample performance. We apply our approach to study the causal relationship between mistrust levels in Africa and historical exposure to the slave trade. Accounting for the two-way clustering by ethnicity and region, our inference method rejects the null hypothesis of uniformly zero effects and uncover heterogeneous treatment effects, with particularly strong impacts in regions with high historical trade intensity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了在多向聚类下，针对一类广泛的因果函数（如条件平均处理效应和连续处理效应）的估计和一致推断方法。该因果函数被识别为依赖于高维 nuisance 参数的 Neyman 正交信号的条件期望。我们引入了一个两步程序：第一步使用机器学习估计 nuisance 参数，第二步将估计的 Neyman 正交信号投影到一组基函数字典上，其维度随样本量增长。我们考虑了全样本和多向交叉拟合两种方法，并推导了所得估计量的函数极限理论。对于一致推断，我们开发了一种新的重抽样方法，即多向聚类稳健筛分数 bootstrap，它将 Chen 和 Christensen (2018) 的筛分数 bootstrap 扩展到多向聚类设置。大量模拟表明，所提出的方法具有良好的有限样本性能。我们将我们的方法应用于研究非洲不信任水平与历史上奴隶贸易暴露之间的因果关系。考虑到按种族和地区的双向聚类，我们的推断方法拒绝了均匀零效应的原假设，并揭示了异质性处理效应，在历史贸易强度高的地区影响尤为显著。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference for large-dimensional generalized matrix factor models
articles.title_cn: 大规模广义矩阵因子模型的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: This article introduces a nonlinear generalized matrix factor model, moving beyond the linear-Gaussian framework to accommodate a broader class of response models typically handled via logit, probit, Poisson, or Tobit structures. We introduce a novel Lagrange multiplier method carefully tailored to ensure that the penalized likelihood function is locally concave around the true factor and loading parameters. This leads to central limit theorems of the estimated factors and loadings which is nontrivial for nonlinear matrix factor modeling. We establish the convergence rates of the estimated factor and loading matrices for the generalized matrix factor model under general conditions that allow for correlations across samples, rows, and columns. We provide a model selection criterion to determine the numbers of row and column factors. Extensive simulation studies demonstrate the superiority in handling discrete and mixed-type variables of the generalized matrix factor model. An empirical data analysis of the company’s operating performance shows that the generalized matrix factor model does clustering and reconstruction well in the presence of discontinuous entries in the data matrix.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种非线性广义矩阵因子模型，超越了线性高斯框架，以适应通常通过logit、probit、Poisson或Tobit结构处理的更广泛的响应模型类别。我们引入了一种新颖的拉格朗日乘子方法，精心定制以确保惩罚似然函数在真实因子和载荷参数附近局部凹性。这导致了估计因子和载荷的中心极限定理，这对于非线性矩阵因子建模而言是非平凡的。我们在允许样本、行和列之间相关的通用条件下，建立了广义矩阵因子模型估计因子和载荷矩阵的收敛速率。我们提供了一种模型选择准则来确定行因子和列因子的数量。广泛的模拟研究表明，广义矩阵因子模型在处理离散和混合类型变量方面具有优越性。对公司经营绩效的实证数据分析表明，广义矩阵因子模型在数据矩阵存在不连续条目时，能够很好地完成聚类和重构。

articles.title_en: Doubly-robust inference for conditional average treatment effects with high-dimensional controls
articles.title_cn: 高维控制变量下条件平均处理效应的双重稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: Plausible identification of conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) can rely on controlling for a large number of variables to account for confounding factors. In these high-dimensional settings, estimation of the CATE requires estimating first-stage models whose consistency relies on correctly specifying their parametric forms. While doubly-robust estimators of the CATE exist, inference procedures based on the second-stage CATE estimator are not doubly-robust. Using the popular augmented inverse propensity weighting signal, we propose an estimator for the CATE whose resulting Wald-type confidence intervals are doubly-robust. We assume a logistic model for the propensity score and a linear model for the outcome regression, and estimate the parameters of these models using an ℓ1 (Lasso) penalty to address the high-dimensional covariates. Inference based on this estimator remains valid even if one of the logistic propensity score or linear outcome regression models are misspecified.
articles.abstract_cn: 条件平均处理效应（CATE）的合理识别可以依赖于控制大量变量以解释混杂因素。在这些高维设置中，估计CATE需要估计第一阶段模型，其一致性依赖于对其参数形式的正确设定。尽管存在CATE的双重稳健估计量，但基于第二阶段CATE估计量的推断程序并非双重稳健。利用流行的增强逆倾向加权信号，我们提出了一种CATE估计量，其生成的Wald型置信区间是双重稳健的。我们假设倾向得分采用逻辑模型，结果回归采用线性模型，并使用ℓ1（Lasso）惩罚来估计这些模型的参数以处理高维协变量。基于该估计量的推断即使逻辑倾向得分或线性结果回归模型之一被错误设定，仍然有效。

articles.title_en: GLS estimation of local projections: Trading robustness for efficiency
articles.title_cn: 局部投影的GLS估计：以稳健性换取效率
articles.abstract_en: Local projections (LPs) are widely used for estimating impulse responses (IRs) as they are considered more robust to model misspecification than forward-iterated IRs from dynamic models such as VARs. However, this robustness comes at the cost of higher variance, particularly at longer horizons. To mitigate this trade-off, several GLS transformations of LPs have been proposed. This paper analyzes two broad strands of GLS-type LP estimators: those that condition on residuals from an auxiliary VAR, and those that condition on residuals from previous-horizon LPs. We show that the former impose a VAR structure, which leads them to align with VAR IRs, while the latter preserve the unrestricted nature of LPs but end up replicating LP OLS estimates. Consequently, the intended efficiency gains are either not achieved or come at the expense of the very robustness that motivates the use of LPs.
articles.abstract_cn: 局部投影（LPs）被广泛用于估计脉冲响应（IRs），因为它们被认为比从动态模型（如VAR）前向迭代得到的IRs对模型误设更具稳健性。然而，这种稳健性以更高的方差为代价，尤其是在较长的时间跨度上。为缓解这一权衡，已有多种LPs的GLS变换被提出。本文分析了两大类GLS型LP估计量：一类以辅助VAR的残差为条件，另一类以先前时间跨度LPs的残差为条件。我们表明，前者施加了VAR结构，使其与VAR IRs一致，而后者保留了LPs的无限制性质，但最终复制了LP OLS估计。因此，预期的效率提升要么未能实现，要么以牺牲促使使用LPs的稳健性为代价。

articles.title_en: On generalized CCE estimation
articles.title_cn: 广义CCE估计
articles.abstract_en: The widely-used common correlated effects (CCE) estimator, pioneered by Pesaran (2006), is computed using least squares applied to auxiliary regressions where the observed regressors are augmented with cross-sectional averages of the dependent variable and regressors. However, the CCE estimator requires a crucial rank condition and becomes inconsistent when this condition is violated and the factor loadings of the x- and y -equations are correlated, causing an endogeneity issue. This paper proposes a generalized CCE (GCCE) estimator by augmenting the regression with both cross-sectional and time-series averages of the regressors. We argue that the time-series average can serve as “control variables” to address the endogeneity issue. We show that the GCCE and CCE estimators are asymptotically equivalent when the rank condition holds, and the GCCE estimator remains consistent even when the rank condition is violated under our “control variable” condition. Therefore, our GCCE estimator is doubly robust, achieving consistency under either the rank condition or the “control variable” condition. Furthermore, we propose a leave-one-out jackknife method to conduct valid inferences regardless of whether the rank condition holds. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate excellent performance of our estimators and inference methods in finite samples. We apply our new methods to two datasets to estimate the production function and gravity equation.
articles.abstract_cn: 由Pesaran（2006）首创的广泛使用的公共相关效应（CCE）估计器，是通过对辅助回归应用最小二乘法计算的，其中观测到的回归变量增加了因变量和回归变量的横截面平均值。然而，CCE估计器需要一个关键的秩条件，当该条件被违反且x方程和y方程的因子载荷相关时，会导致内生性问题，从而使估计不一致。本文通过增加回归变量和回归变量的横截面平均值及时间序列平均值，提出了一种广义CCE（GCCE）估计器。我们认为时间序列平均值可以作为“控制变量”来解决内生性问题。我们证明，当秩条件成立时，GCCE和CCE估计器是渐近等价的，而在我们的“控制变量”条件下，即使秩条件被违反，GCCE估计器仍然保持一致。因此，我们的GCCE估计器具有双重稳健性，在秩条件或“控制变量”条件下都能实现一致性。此外，我们提出了一种留一法刀切法，无论秩条件是否成立，都能进行有效的推断。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了我们的估计器和推断方法在有限样本中的优异表现。我们将新方法应用于两个数据集，以估计生产函数和引力方程。

articles.title_en: Efficient estimation of structural models via sieves
articles.title_cn: 通过筛子对结构模型的有效估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a class of sieve-based efficient estimators for structural models (SEES), which approximate the solution using a linear combination of basis functions and impose equilibrium conditions as a penalty to determine the best-fitting coefficients. Our estimators circumvent repeated solution of the structural model, apply to a broad class of models, and are consistent, asymptotically normal, and asymptotically efficient. Moreover, they solve unconstrained optimization problems with fewer unknowns and offer convenient standard error calculations. As an illustration, we apply our method to an entry game between Walmart and Kmart.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类基于筛子的结构模型有效估计器（SEES），该方法使用基函数的线性组合来近似解，并通过施加均衡条件作为惩罚来确定最佳拟合系数。我们的估计器避免了重复求解结构模型，适用于广泛类别的模型，并且具有一致性、渐近正态性和渐近有效性。此外，它们解决了具有较少未知数的无约束优化问题，并提供了便捷的标准误计算。作为示例，我们将该方法应用于沃尔玛和凯马特之间的进入博弈。

articles.title_en: Identification in nonlinear dynamic panel models under partial stationarity
articles.title_cn: 部分平稳性下非线性动态面板模型的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a general identification approach for a wide range of nonlinear panel data models, including binary choice, ordered response, and other types of limited dependent variable models. Our approach accommodates dynamic models with any number of lagged dependent variables as well as other types of endogenous covariates. Our identification strategy relies on a partial stationarity condition, which allows for not only an unknown distribution of errors, but also temporal dependencies in errors. We derive partial identification results under flexible model specifications and establish sharpness of our identified set in the binary choice setting. We demonstrate the robust finite-sample performance of our approach using Monte Carlo simulations, and apply the approach to the empirical analysis of income categories using various ordered choice models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为广泛的非线性面板数据模型提供了一种通用的识别方法，包括二元选择、有序响应以及其他类型的受限因变量模型。我们的方法适用于具有任意数量滞后因变量的动态模型以及其他类型的内生协变量。我们的识别策略依赖于部分平稳性条件，该条件不仅允许误差分布未知，还允许误差存在时间依赖性。我们在灵活模型设定下推导出部分识别结果，并在二元选择设定中确立了识别集的锐利性。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法稳健的有限样本性能，并将该方法应用于使用各种有序选择模型对收入类别的实证分析。

articles.title_en: Dynamic panel data quantile regression with network-linked fixed effects
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a dynamic panel data quantile regression model with network-linked fixed effects, named DQR-NFE, in which unobserved individual heterogeneity is structured through an underlying network. The corresponding estimator is derived by incorporating a quantile network cohesion (QNC) penalty into the dynamic panel quantile regression framework. This penalty encourages connected units within the network to exhibit similar conditional quantiles, with a particularly increased capacity to capture tail network dependence. Relative to conventional fixed-effects specifications, the proposed framework improves the estimation of unobserved heterogeneity and enables more accurate prediction in cold-start settings where training data are unavailable. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the DQR-NFE estimators within a general nonlinear structural framework. These theoretical guarantees hold under both correctly specified and misspecified network structures, with an explicit characterization of their dependence on the network topology. Simulation studies and empirical applications reveal that the proposed estimator outperforms competing approaches in terms of both estimation accuracy and out-of-sample forecasting.

articles.title_en: Inference for two-stage experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies inference in two-stage randomized experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization. In the initial stage of this experimental design, clusters (e.g., households, schools, or graph partitions) are stratified and randomly assigned to control or treatment groups based on cluster-level covariates. Subsequently, an independent second-stage design is carried out, wherein units within each treated cluster are further stratified and randomly assigned to either control or treatment groups, based on individual-level covariates. Under the homogeneous partial interference assumption, I establish conditions under which the proposed difference-in-“average of averages” estimators are consistent and asymptotically normal for the corresponding average primary and spillover effects and develop consistent estimators of their asymptotic variances. Combining these results establishes the asymptotic validity of tests based on these estimators. My findings suggest that ignoring covariate information in the design stage can result in efficiency loss, and commonly used inference methods that ignore or improperly use covariate information can lead to either conservative or invalid inference. Then, I apply these results to studying optimal use of covariate information under covariate-adaptive randomization in large samples, and demonstrate that a specific generalized matched-pair design achieves minimum asymptotic variance for each proposed estimator. Finally, I discuss covariate adjustment, which incorporates additional baseline covariates not used for treatment assignment. The practical relevance of the theoretical results is illustrated through a simulation study and an empirical application.

articles.title_en: A simple, robust identification approach for first-price auctions
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new approach to the identification of first-price auctions that is robust to overbidding, but at the same time remains contiguous with the canonical point-identification approach of Guerre et al. (2000) (GPV) and its simple estimators. We show that a weak identifying restriction allows us to reinterpret the GPV estimates as a bound. We demonstrate that the identifying restriction holds in a set of commonly used auction models that can generate overbidding and is satisfied in the bid data from a laboratory experiment. We illustrate the approach in applications to laboratory data and field data. We recommend that practitioners continue to follow the GPV approach, but interpret the estimates as a bound in applications where they are concerned about overbidding.
